on StudyGuideOutputUpdate lock screen local tStack local tGroupName local tTop,tLeft,tRight local tSectionHTML put StudyGuideOutputGroupID into tGroupName put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName // SET STACK if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then put "Appli_Player" into tStack else put "Appli" into tStack end if put the top of group tGroupName into tTop // DELETE OLD MESSGES WHEN IN DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT if the environment = "development" then if exists(group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = true then delete group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of stack tStack repeat with xGroup = the number of groups of group tGroupName of stack tStack down to 1 if the short name of group xGroup of group tGroupName of stack tStack begins with "rectangle cs" then next repeat end if delete group xGroup of group tGroupName of stack tStack end repeat end if end if // CLEAR ALL MESSAGES repeat with xGroup = the number of groups of group tGroupName of stack tStack down to 1 if the short name of group xGroup of group tGroupName of stack tStack begins with "rectangle cs" then next repeat end if delete group xGroup of group tGroupName of stack tStack end repeat if exists(group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = false then CreateTemplate end if repeat with xSection = 1 to item 2 of the extents of StudyGuideDisplay["sections"] if exists(group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = false then CreateSectionGroup xSection end if set the visible of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the visible of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the width of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the width of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack - 8 // UPDATE THE SECTION TEXT put "

" & StudyGuideDisplay["sections"][xSection]["topic"] & "

" into tSectionHTML put "

" & StudyGuideDisplay["sections"][xSection]["text"] & "

" after tSectionHTML set the htmlText field "Text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tSectionHTML set the width of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to (the width of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack - 8) set the width of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to (the width of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) - 10 set the height of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to (the formattedheight of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) set the height of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to (the formattedheight of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 10) set the top of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the top of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the left of of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the left of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the left of of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the left of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 4 set the top of of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the top of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 5 set the visible of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true set the visible of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true set the height of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the height of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 8 //set the rect of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack // set the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack // set the loc of field "text" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the loc of graphic "bg" of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the left of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the left of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 4 set the visible of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true set the top of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tTop add (the height of group ("section " & xSection) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) to tTop add 4 to tTop -- GAP BETWEEN TOPICS end repeat set the hscroll of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0 set the vscroll of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0 if the formattedheight of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack > the height of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack then set the vscrollbar of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true else set the vscrollbar of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false end if lock screen end StudyGuideOutputUpdate on CreateTemplate // HERE WE CREATE THE TEMPLATE FOR A CHAT BUBBLE // A CHAT BUBBLE NEEDS A BACKGROUND, TEXT, IMAGE, BUTTON, SECONDARY BUBBLE local tStack,tScript local tGroupName local tChatArchive put StudyGuideOutputGroupID into tGroupName put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName // SET STACK if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then put "Appli_Player" into tStack else put "Appli" into tStack end if // GROUP create invisible group "Section Template" in group tGroupName of group "center" of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the opaque of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the visible of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the threed of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the margins of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0 set the lockloc of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true set the showborder of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false // BACKDROP create graphic "bg" in group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the opaque of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true set the style of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "roundrect" set the roundradius of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 15 set the blendlevel of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0 set the height of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 400 set the width of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 300 set the linesize of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 2 set the foregroundcolor of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#939393" set the backgroundcolor of graphic "bg" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#f5f5f5" // MESSAGE TEXT create field "Text" in group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the opaque of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the threed of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the showborder of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the locktext of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true set the showfocusborder of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the traversalon of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false set the textColor of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#000000" set the textsize of field "Text" of group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 28 end CreateTemplate on CreateSectionGroup pSectionNumber local tGroupName,tStack put StudyGuideOutputGroupID into tGroupName put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName // SET STACK if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then put "Appli_Player" into tStack else put "Appli" into tStack end if copy group "Section Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack set the name of it to "section " & pSectionNumber end CreateSectionGroup
